about: Every SwapUp release: the commits, and each APK's version, versionCode, commit and sha256 — never the APK, an env file or a key. deploy/release.sh adds an entry after each deploy; commit it.

releases.note: Added by hand from the 0.9.0 release log (released by a session script before deploy/release.sh existed). Its full APK sha256s were not kept on this Mac; the live ones are in /var/www/swapup-downloads/swapup-*.json on the VM.
